theme: Dark/Light toggle (Default: Dark Mode - Deep Obsidian)

headings.usage: H1, H2, H3. High impact, premium feel. Never use Inter for headings.

body.usage: Use for readable paragraphs, descriptions, and dashboard data.

accents_mono.usage: Overlines, labels, numbers, cost calculator outputs, technical badges.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl or 2xl with bg-white/70 (light) or bg-black/60 (dark) + 1px border. Never use 100% transparent backgrounds for headers or overlays.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Restrained use of electric blue-to-violet accents (e.g., bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-500 to-violet-500). DO NOT use full-screen flat gradients. Favor 3D mesh gradients behind glass.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient + Direct shadows. Dark mode relies heavily on surface shifts (bg-white/5) and 1px borders rather than heavy drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: Subtle border-white/10 on dark mode for a Linear-style crispness.

component_rules.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rounded-md with interaction animations. Primary CTA uses Electric Blue. Hover states must explicitly set text and background color.
component_rules.cards: Flat background with 1px subtle border, no shadow in dark mode. On hover: translate-y-1, border color brightens.
component_rules.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Textarea, Select. Heavily customize to remove standard template look. Ensure accessible focus rings.
component_rules.navigation: Sticky top with glassmorphism (z-50). Visible links on desktop. Dark mode header must have background, not transparent.
component_rules.dashboards: High density, pure functionality. Avoid Space Grotesk here. Use Inter for data readability. Tight grids, minimal padding.

grids.marketing: Asymmetric Bento Grid (Tetris Mode). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Create visual tension.
grids.dashboard: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6. Maximize data correlation.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing philosophy. p-8 to p-24 for marketing sections. Containers with borders must have internal padding to prevent collision.
layouts.hero: Max overlay opacity bg-black/50 if image used. Floating browser previews and refined 3D/parallax effects requested.
layouts.responsive: Mobile first. Hide complex 3D on mobile if it hurts performance. Max mobile image height 80vh.

motion.interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements. Staggered entrance animations for lists. Smooth scrolling for marketing pages.

accessibility.contrast: APCA or WCAG AA standards. Minimum 4.5:1 for body text.
accessibility.focus: High contrast focus rings. focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-black.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute.

media.images: High quality, conceptual and relevant. Do not stretch. Use object-cover. Images over dark mode must pop.
media.icons: lucide-react for default crisp icons. Use uniformly sized and stroke-width icons.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use Framer Motion for pseudo-3D parallax or tilt effects. Keep it performant.

explanation.visual_direction: A fusion of Apple's crispness, Linear's precision, and Awwwards' creativity. Uses deep obsidian backgrounds, restrained electric blue to violet accents, and high-contrast glassmorphism.
explanation.layout: Marketing pages utilize the 'Tetris' Bento Grid for asymmetric storytelling. Dashboards utilize high-density, cardless grids prioritizing data hierarchy and functionality.
explanation.information_architecture: Public Site captures leads via portfolio, services, and calculator. Admin Dashboard centralizes content control. Client Portal centralizes project management and approvals.
explanation.responsive_strategy: Mobile-first approach. Complex grids collapse to single columns on mobile. Navigation shifts to a full-screen glass menu. Images capped at 80vh to prevent scrolling fatigue.
explanation.interaction_states: Micro-interactions on every clickable element. Floating browser previews in hero. Hover states shift colors and elevate components slightly.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a production-level, high-fidelity app for Qwebliq LLP.
Implement both Marketing Website (public) and Platform areas (Admin & Client dashboards).
Use Sora for Headings, Inter for Body, and Space Grotesk sparingly for numerical/techy accents.
Ensure dark/light theme toggle. Default should be dark mode reflecting a premium tech agency.
Apply Linear-style aesthetics: subtle 1px borders, deep black/charcoal backgrounds, electric blue/violet accents.
Integrate Framer Motion for scroll-triggered reveals, floating elements, and button hover states.
DO NOT output raw HTML for standard interactions—use Radix/Shadcn primitives (Dropdowns, Accordions, Dialogs).
CRITICAL: Output .js/.jsx syntax as per the workspace constraints, DO NOT use TypeScript (.tsx).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Every interaction needs micro-animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Add subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states.
Main agent relies on provided image URLs. NEVER use placeholder text.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
